channel.title: River 川
channel.description: Short texts by Yoso that move like a quiet river: on breath, love, spring and surrendering to the flow.

item.title: Before reaching the shore
item.description:
Before reaching the shore,
in the quiet sea of abstraction;
Seize the mind.

– Yoso

item.title: To feel with opened eyes
item.description:
To feel with opened eyes,
to listen with the heart,
to speak with truth.

– Yoso

item.title: Wind’s Natural Soul
item.description:
Wind’s Natural Soul…
Leading me to the unknown…
Transcendental Flow.

– Yoso

item.title: Breathe in
item.description:
Breathe in…
Breathe out…
The energy that connects all forms…
Infinite chains of chemical reactions…
Trillions of cells living within…
What am I?

– Yoso

item.title: Kind loving love
item.description:
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love.

– Yoso

item.title: Submissiveness
item.description:
Submissiveness,
alien to the shining soul,
breathing union is.

– Yoso

item.title: I surrender to the flow
item.description:
I surrender to the flow…
Reaching the depth of my heart…
Union’s Embrace.

– Yoso

item.title: Spring Energy
item.description:
Spring Energy,
Blessing our hearts with promising light.
Each blossom, a vow of harmony.
With gratitude, I honour your transience.

– Yoso

item.title: Awakening Mind
item.description:
Awakening mind…
That which is conscious…
For the good of sentience.

– Yoso

item.title: Present, mindful now
item.description:
Present, mindful now.
Peaceful heart, a quiet mind.
Harmony’s embrace.

– Yoso

item.title: Being is beyond knowledge
item.description:
Being is beyond knowledge,
being is integrity,
being is the totality.

The totality of your experiences,
The sacred energy that unites past and future to the present moment!

– Yoso

item.title: To each cell
item.description:
Hands in prayer,
I bow respectfully to each cell in my body,
and to the life in you.

– Yoso

item.title: Heal yourself to heal others
item.description:
Heal yourself to heal others,
Heal others to heal yourself.

– Yoso

item.title: First Love, Then Form
item.description:
First Love, Then Form.

– Yoso

item.title: There is no greater shock in life than birth
item.description:
There is no greater shock in life than birth,
Fighting for survival,
Death is release,

– Yoso

item.title: Life itself
item.description:
Life itself...
Is death itself...

Full circle,
Balance,
Dance...

Transfer of energy...
Consciousness...

Survival...

– Yoso

item.title: In modern times
item.description:
In modern times,
We acquire knowledge,
believing that it is the truth,
only to realize that it is only part of it!

Life itself is knowledge!
Within Life itself resides the knowledge!
The multitude of Life forms that created our being!
It is when we tune in, that all become one!

When we surrender with gratitude,
when we learn to respect!
that our knowledge requires energy to survive,
that survival itself is ephemeral!

that each breath matters more than knowledge!
and that at the end of the day,
life itself is the experience!

– Yoso

item.title: End of Summer Full moon
item.description:
End of Summer Full moon,
Bright in the East…
I could feel the cold wind in the morning rise…
Summer afternoon…
Feeling the Rain coming when you set your light…
It took me half a century to recognize, that both the Sun and you…
Made me who I have become…
A modern man seeking revenge on modern civilisation..
For hiding your beauty for so long..
I am back, and choose to celebrate your dance and gentle light, until the last day of my winter…
Let me celebrate many sunrises…

– Yoso

item.title: Being One
item.description:
Being One.
Becoming one.
microcosm and Macrocosm.
One

– Yoso

item.title: With each petal in the wind
item.description:
With each petal in the wind,
I vow to dedicate myself to prosperity and harmony for sentient life.

– Yoso

item.title: Like a petal in the wind
item.description:
Like a petal in the wind,
I surrender to the flow...

– Yoso

item.title: Do not love Love
item.description:
Do not love Love,
Be love,
Love.

– Yoso

item.title: The spring awakes
item.description:
The spring awakes,
The Golden Heart is Here!
Pure Counsciousness.

– Yoso

item.title: Your Mind is your home
item.description:
Your Mind is your home

– Yoso

item.title: With each blossom
item.description:
With each blossom,
I vow to dedicate myself to prosperity and harmony for sentient life.

– Yoso

item.title: A quiet river
item.description:
Thank you for always being by my side.
With you, my heart flows like a quiet river.

– Yoso
